parameters.query: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE state IN ('error', 'failed')) AS errors, count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'queued' AND sent_at < now() - interval '24 hours') AS stale FROM automation.device_profile

WITH input AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(name text, ok boolean, detail text)
),
failing AS (
  INSERT INTO automation.alert_state AS a (check_name, failing_since, last_notified, detail)
  SELECT name, now(), now(), detail FROM input WHERE NOT ok
  ON CONFLICT (check_name) DO UPDATE
    SET detail = EXCLUDED.detail,
        last_notified = CASE WHEN a.last_notified < now() - interval '6 hours' THEN now() ELSE a.last_notified END
  RETURNING check_name, detail, (last_notified = now()) AS notify
),
recovered AS (
  DELETE FROM automation.alert_state
  WHERE check_name IN (SELECT name FROM input WHERE ok)
  RETURNING check_name, failing_since
)
SELECT 'alarm' AS kind, check_name, detail FROM failing WHERE notify
UNION ALL
SELECT 'ok', check_name, to_char(failing_since AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin', 'DD.MM. HH24:MI') FROM recovered

meta.description: Alle 10 Minuten: oeffentliche Endpunkte (SCEP, Enrollment-Profil, MDM-Endpunkt) von aussen ansprechen, TLS-Zertifikat des oeffentlichen Hosts auf Gueltigkeit pruefen, Pod-Gesundheit ueber VictoriaMetrics (kube-state-metrics) abfragen sowie fehlgeschlagene oder haengende Profil-Installationen melden. Alarme werden pro Pruefung hoechstens alle 6 Stunden wiederholt, die Entwarnung kommt einmal (Zustand in automation.alert_state). Credentials: MDM NanoDEP API, MDM Automation DB, ntfy-publisher.
